relation_to_idea.conceptual_difference: This work uses KG embeddings in a similar semantic space for multi-hop QA. Our idea enriches training triples with local context subgraphs from the same passage and adds an adaptive repair loop for one-hop failures, focusing on training data enrichment and iterative correction rather than KG embedding space similarity.
